bed_liedown.note: Bed P1. Seated on the bed edge facing +Z -> leans onto the LEFT side/elbow, lifts both legs, ends lying on the back with the head toward his left (+X). 4.0 s, Hunyuan (already bought batch), screened: knees always forward, hips 0.44-0.58 m (it lies on a raised bed, not the floor). Not a loop; root moves 0.22 m sideways (place in code). Real-mesh render: the arms flail a little mid-roll; bed_liedown_alt is calmer.

bed_liedown_alt.note: Recommended over bed_liedown after the real-mesh render: calmer, no arm flailing. Seated on the edge facing +Z -> leans onto the left side, legs up, ends on the back, head toward +X. 4.0 s.

bed_getup.note: Bed P2. Lying on the back, head toward +X -> pushes up, legs swing down, ends SEATED on the edge facing about +Z. 4.0 s, knees forward.

bed_roll_back2side_L.note: Lying on the back -> rolls onto his LEFT side (with head at +X that faces the room +Z). 3.0 s, 67 deg roll.

bed_roll_back2side_R.note: Lying on the back -> rolls onto his RIGHT side (faces the wall when the head is at +X). 3.0 s.

bed_roll_side2back_L.note: Side -> back (mirror pair of _R; pick the one that starts from the side he is on). 3.0 s, 80 deg.

bed_roll_side2stomach_L.note: Side -> stomach (ends about 30 deg short of flat; let the mattress fit finish it). 3.0 s.

stool_sitdown.note: Real mocap. Standing facing +Z, sits down on a low stool (seat ~0.45 m), 2.2 s, native tempo (speed 1).

stool_sit_idle.note: Real mocap. Seated idle on a stool, hands moving a little, feet planted. 5.1 s, loop it with close 0.8.

stool_standup.note: Real mocap. Seated -> stands up, 1.5 s.

eat_sit.note: Seated eating at a table: legs/hips seated on a stool (13_04), upper body real 'eating' mocap (80_24): left hand holds the plate ~chest/table level, right hand spoon to mouth twice. 6.6 s loop (close 0.6). Legs ping-pong under it, almost still.

drink_stand.note: Real mocap. Standing, right hand lifts a cup to the mouth and down. 7.3 s. Subject 79 legs are stiff (knee data flat) but standing still.

chop_axe.note: Outdoor P1. Real mocap, two-handed overhead axe chop into a block: raise, strike (hands lowest at ~0.9 m at both ends), one 1.85 s cycle, loop (close 0.3).

chop_axe_long.note: Four chops in a row (7.7 s) with natural variation between swings.

hammer_stand.note: Real mocap. Standing, bent forward, hammering a nail at ~0.9 m (bench, railing, wall at chest after IK). 9.7 s loop (close 0.6). Workshop/repair.

hammer_kneel.note: Repair P1. RIGHT knee on the floor, left foot forward (real kneel 23_03, ping-pong) + real hammering upper body (62_07). Hands work low in front. 9.7 s loop.

pull_nail.note: Real mocap. Pulling a nail out, standing bent forward.

saw_hand.note: Real mocap. Hand saw strokes, standing, torso steady. 13 s loop.

stir_stand.note: Kitchen P1. Real mocap mixing/stirring with the right hand at chest height, left holds the bowl, legs still, torso upright. 13 s loop.

sweep.note: Real mocap. Sweeping the floor with a broom, small steps; right hand on top of the handle (near the chin), left hand low. Trimmed to 18.4 s so the hand switch is gone. Attach the broom to both hands (top = RightHand).

squat_pickup.note: Outdoor P3. Real mocap: squats, picks an object up from the ground, rises. 2.3 s.

squat_work.note: Repair P4. Real mocap: deep squat, both hands working at the floor (knots at the ladder foot). 3.3 s, ping-pong or loop with close 0.6.

carry_heavy_R.note: Outdoor P2 / walk. Real mocap walking with a heavy (9 kg) case in the RIGHT hand, body leans away. 7.5 s, root moves 2.8 m. For motion matching DB or as an upper-body overlay.

carry_light_walk.note: Walking with a light case (2.5 kg).

turn_in_place_a.note: Real mocap turn in place (several turns). Motion matching DB.

look_around.note: Leisure P2 (deck 'look'). Real mocap 'normal wait': upright, looks around, turns ~85 deg to the right with two small steps, no crouch. 12 s. Play once (not a loop: it ends turned), or mirror-alternate. (Replaced 77_04/139_03: that actor crouches like a scout.)

stretch_yawn.note: Leisure P3. Real mocap: stretch and yawn, standing. 6.2 s.

wipe_window.note: Real mocap wiping a window/surface at chest-head height (use for drying a plate / wiping).

wash_hands_front.note: CORRECTION after the real-mesh render: 79_90 'washing' is washing the face/head (hands go up to the face), not dishes. Use it for washing the face at the bucket/pond; for dishes keep hy_wash (its clip data has correct knees). 15.3 s, standing legs from 80_16.

set_cup_down.note: Real mocap: setting a glass of water down.

ledge_dangle.note: Leisure P1 (replaces hy_dangle). Real mocap legs hanging from a high edge (01_08), swing damped 55% so it reads as idle dangling, + calm seated upper body (14_31, hands near the thighs). 3.5 s, loop close 0.8. Hips ~1.3 m above the mocap floor: place the root on the ledge in code.

idle_stand_a.note: Replacement for clip '30' (standing base under cook / tea / water). Real mocap standing, relaxed, weight shifts. 15.6 s loop close 1.0. Head lifted (headlevel.mjs): the capture hung the head ~34 deg forward, now ~14 deg like a normal gaze.

idle_stand_b.note: Standing, shifting weight between feet. 7.8 s loop close 0.8. Head lifted (headlevel.mjs): the capture hung the head ~34 deg forward, now ~14 deg like a normal gaze.

idle_wait.note: Normal waiting: looks around, shifts, folds arms now and then. 31 s loop close 1.0.

idle_tired.note: REJECTED after the real-mesh review (do not use): 137_32 is an 'old man' wait, trunk bent forward 58 deg with bent knees, which looks crippled on the young hero; limiting the lean made him crouch and stare upward. For a tired hero use idle_stand_b (calm, small weight shifts) or sit_tired.

jacket_on.note: Real mocap putting on a jacket, standing. 9 s.

coat_on.note: Putting on a coat, slower, second actor. 17 s.

reach_up_hold.note: Repair P2 base: both hands held up at head height (~1.45 m) as if holding a board/shingle up; strike with the right hand via IK/overlay. 9.8 s.

box_pickup_knees.note: Pick a box up from the floor bending the knees, ends holding it at the chest (armful of logs). 3 s.

box_pickup_waist.note: Pick a box up bending from the waist. 3.9 s.

sit_ground.note: Sitting on the ground relaxing (hips 0.27 m). 18.7 s loop close 1.0.

sit_tired.note: Bed P5 / evening. Real mocap seated on a low seat, forearms on the knees, hands together in front of the chest, small fidgets, calm. 5.8 s, loop close 0.8.

telescope_look.note: Deck telescope (replaces hy_telescope, whose right knee bent back). Calm standing legs (77_02) + both hands held up in front of the face (80_07, holding something at head height), small natural sway. 7.8 s loop close 0.8. Snap the hands to the tube and the eye to the eyepiece with IK; root still.

carry_heavy_L.note: Mirror of carry_heavy_R: heavy load in the LEFT hand.

carry_bucket_R.note: Outdoor P2 / pond. carry_heavy_R with the right hand held 0.30 m out from the pelvis so a bucket (0.28 m wide, ~0.25 m below the hand) clears the leg in every frame (it hit the knee by up to 12 cm in the suitcase clip), torso leans ~7 deg away from the load. Built by pipeline/clips/bucket.mjs. 7.5 s, root moves 2.8 m.

carry_bucket_L.note: Same as carry_bucket_R, bucket in the LEFT hand.

turn90_L.note: One 90 deg turn in place to the LEFT, real stepping feet (69_16 first turn). Play at speed 1.3-1.6 for a brisk turn; chain two for 180 deg. Head lifted (headlevel.mjs): the capture hung the head ~34 deg forward, now ~14 deg like a normal gaze.

turn90_L_b.note: Second 90 deg left turn take (69_16), slightly different footwork; alternate with turn90_L. Head lifted (headlevel.mjs): the capture hung the head ~34 deg forward, now ~14 deg like a normal gaze.

turn90_R.note: One 90 deg turn in place to the RIGHT, real stepping feet (69_18). Same use as turn90_L. Head lifted (headlevel.mjs): the capture hung the head ~34 deg forward, now ~14 deg like a normal gaze.

turn90_R_b.note: Second 90 deg right turn take (69_18). Head lifted (headlevel.mjs): the capture hung the head ~34 deg forward, now ~14 deg like a normal gaze.

sweep_L.note: Same actor sweeping with the hands swapped: LEFT hand on top of the handle, right hand low. 4.3 s (the turn-away at the end is cut).

walk_start.note: Real mocap: standing still, then starting to walk forward (+Z), reaches ~0.9 m/s. Blend into the walk cycle at the end.

walk_stop.note: Real mocap: walking at ~0.8 m/s, then stopping on both feet. Blend in from the walk cycle at the start.

walk_stop_b.note: Second walk-stop take (16_34), slightly longer settle.

listen_window.note: Procedural on idle_stand_b (listen.mjs): over 1.3 s he leans in ~6 deg, turns his head ~13 deg toward the glass and tilts it ~16 deg (ear to the window), holds with the base breathing/weight shifts and a slow head drift, eases out over 1.3 s. 7.8 s, root still. Face the window with the RIGHT side of the head slightly forward; a hand on the sill comes from grab. Built with node listen.mjs hero.glb out/idle_stand_b.json out/listen_window.json 9.

bootsoff_sit_R.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 5). Sitting on the bed edge: lifts the RIGHT foot only to knee height, leans forward and pulls the boot off with both hands (~1.2-3.4 s), then reaches down to the right side to set it on the floor outside the right foot (~4.0 s), sits back up. 5 s. Arms pushed out of torso/thighs by fixpen.

bootsoff_sit_L.note: Mirror of bootsoff_sit_R: LEFT boot, set down on the left side.

kneel_fill.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 23). Walks in, kneels on one knee, the right hand reaches forward and down to ~0.1 m (water edge ~0.5 m in front of the knees), holds, stands up. 5 s. For filling the bucket at the pond.

bucket_dump.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 11). Standing two-hand dump: bucket held at the waist in front, tipped forward and down (over a rail), lowered. 4 s; hands ~0.7-1.0 m high.

bucket_dump_b.note: Second dump take (seed 23), deeper forward tip (trunk lean up to ~47 deg).

rail_lean.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 11). Forearms on a rail at ~1.0 m, weight on one leg, slowly looks left and right. 8 s, root still (loop with close 1.0).

floor_pickup.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 23) floor pickup: bends at the waist and squats, both hands to ~0.2 m in front of the feet, stands up holding the load at the waist. Knees opened to >=40 deg interior by kneeopen.mjs (raw clip folded them to 23 deg = calf through thigh), hips raised up to 12 cm, trunk bent a bit more. 4 s. Replacement for hy_pickground.

clear_leaves.note: hy_clearleaves from master (36 fps, 150 frames) with the loop seam smoothed circularly (knee jerk at the seam 8.8 -> 0.4 cm/frame^2) and planted feet flattened (heel lowered up to 7 cm, footflat.mjs). Loop.

squat_work_flat.note: squat_work with heels down on the boards (footflat.mjs), knees >=40 deg interior (kneeopen.mjs) and a smoothed loop seam. Hands in front of the knees at board level. Replacement for hy_squatwork (fix_rope).

seated_listen.note: Procedural on sit_tired (listen.mjs + headlevel): sitting, hands resting on the thighs/knees, leans in ~6 deg, head turned ~13 deg and tilted ~16 deg as if listening (radio), slow head drift. 5.8 s, loop with close 0.8.

stairs_up3.note: Real mocap: walks forward up 3 steps of ~0.16 m (hero scale; risers at about z=+0.45, +0.6, +0.75 from the start), stops on top. Root rises 0.48 m. For Motion (step-up / stairs), not for flat walking.

stairs_down3.note: Real mocap: walks forward down 3 steps of ~0.16 m and stops on the floor. Root drops 0.48 m.

bootsoff_sit_R2.note: bootsoff_sit_R toned down for the gate: the right leg lifts only ~55% as high (foot max 0.39 m, about mid-shin of the other leg), neck/head flexion capped (neckcap.mjs: neck<=42, head<=54 deg from vertical), trunk lean <=21 deg, head stays >=0.8 m from either foot and 0.3 m above the knee. Hands no longer reach the boot by themselves: drive them with grab.

sneak_walk.note: Real mocap (CMU 17_03 walk stealthily): crouched sneaking walk, hips ~9 cm lower than standing, ~0.4 m/s. One full gait cycle (1.33 s, matched start/end pose) -> loop, close 0.15. Play speed ~1.3 for a 1 s cycle; remove root motion (rm) for in place. In place (hips x/z zeroed), seam smoothed. Arms held out for balance.

sneak_walk_b.note: Real mocap (CMU 77_14 careful creeping): second sneaking cycle, 1.33 s, more upright arms-ready look. Loop, close 0.15. In place, seam smoothed. Arms low and ready: better with a bow in hand. Recommended.

bow_shoot.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 23): reaches over the right shoulder for the bow, brings it to the left hand, nocks, raises the left arm, draws to the right cheek, aims, releases, lowers. 5 s, in place.

pick_hare.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 23): drops to one knee, right hand picks something small off the ground (~0.5 s-1.3 s), stands, puts it into a sack at the right hip (~2.4 s). 3 s, in place; knee bend max 139 deg.

scan_bow.note: Fal Hunyuan (bought, seed 23): stands still, bow down in the left hand, listens and slowly scans left/right with small weight shifts. Head lifted (headlevel). 6 s loop, seam smoothed.
